# Arya

> Arya is an open-source video and motion editor. Projects remain editable; core editing and export are free. Optional tips support development.

## Official pages

- [Website](https://editwitharya.app/): Official product information and edition comparison.
- [Downloads](https://editwitharya.app/download/): Current verified releases and checksums.
- [Installation and setup](https://editwitharya.app/install/): Installation, optional assistant connections, updates and rollback.
- [Project status](https://editwitharya.app/project/): Supported features, limits and source links.
- [Support and tips](https://editwitharya.app/support/): Contact options and optional one-time support.
- [Privacy](https://editwitharya.app/privacy/): Local storage, optional services and payment processing.

## Source

- [Source code](https://github.com/rubix-labs-hq/arya): MIT-licensed repository and issue tracker.

## Full reference

- [Detailed product reference](https://editwitharya.app/llms-full.txt)
